question: How should the40 in-flight requests and repeated attempts be counted, and can440 failures be reported as440 harmed users?

criteria.instruction: The40 in-flight W1 requests are reported separately and excluded from both completed counts, not assumed successful/failed. Retries count as distinct requests for this operational metric but may belong to the same user. The440 combined failed requests are not a deduplicated harmed-user count.
Cite M6 and counter/trace evidence describing completion and retry definitions; unique impact needs a separate user/session join.
Decline an exact harmed-user total or claim that all retries eventually succeeded. No such outcome/deduplication dataset is supplied.
